work.name: Majority Labs
highlights: Spearheaded the transition from a Rails to React front end using Webpacker, delivering a more dynamic and responsive user interface, enhancing user engagement.
Designed a dynamic query interface with React pagination functionality, significantly reducing response time for query requests, improving user experience and enabling complex audience targeting.

Developed comprehensive feature and end-to-end test suites post-transition to React, covering 75% of the codebase, ensuring robust functionality and seamless user transition, resulting in no user down time.

Developed a geographic endpoint interfacing with the OpenNorth API to perform geographic information segmentation and analysis, including the creation of a background job system to efficiently populate data while addressing rate limitations from the API.
